Disable BFD echo mode; Local Pref = 150
Behind stateless CEs with HA state sync
Shared NAT pool for Microsoft Peering
Never drop asymmetric ECMP return flows
Advertise IDENTICAL prefix lengths as ER!
- Route Azure VPN GW Public IP to Internet

Carries traffic ONLY if ER circuit/site fails
Warning: /25 on VPN beats /24 on ER (LPM!)
Not suitable for high-BW / low-latency SLAs

2. ER GW <-> MSEE failover takes up to ~60 sec
3. Separate maintenance windows for ER & VPN GWs

Migrate legacy SKUs via Guided Gateway Migration
No native ER <-> VPN transit without Route Server / vWAN
